svg.aria-label: skim concept: no RPC provider, your own verified peer on the Ethereum P2P network

g.text: Today, your app borrows someone else's node
…and you can't check what they send you.
skim: your own peer on the Ethereum network
Ethereum P2P · no provider, no API key
Blocks say exactly what changed: no re-execution, no full sync.
Every value is proven against the block
unproven is never served · unknown is never zero
(the chain head itself is trusted from gossip today; sync-committee light-client checks are next)
Sync (and archive) only what you need
No more RPC subscriptions. P2P, with verification.
